newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas sees first trade on new prompt contract.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas sees first trade on new prompt contract.

text.p: The IPE natural gas futures contract saw the first trade on the new Balance of the Month contract on Monday afternoon, although total volumes traded were thin.

A total of 200 lots were traded, with October seeing the highest individual volume of trade at 75 lots. Prices were mixed, with September and October up from Friday's settlement while December and next August slipped.
The total of 200 lots compares with 255 lots traded on Friday and 540 lots on Thursday, but physical traders said the OTC market had also been extremely quiet on Monday.
In the last hour of trade, a single 25-lot deal was done in the new Balance of the Month contract at 9.00 pence a therm. This was the first trade done since the new contract was launched on August 8.
